selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed no native snapshot tooling existed, installed btrfs-progs, built and formatted a loopback btrfs image, and mounted it as /srv/data with a 'data' subvolume.
Added an /etc/fstab entry using loop,subvol=data and verified a clean umount/mount -a round trip mounts /srv/data correctly.

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline application data and snapshot captured
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote config.yaml, accounts.csv, audit.log to /srv/data/app, recorded sha256 checksums, then created read-only btrfs snapshot ID 257 of the data subvolume.
Deleted accounts.csv, overwrote config.yaml, appended to audit.log, and added malware.txt; checksums confirm divergence from baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Exact restoration of earlier snapshot content
selected_evidence.summary: Deleted mutated subvolume, created new writable snapshot from the read-only baseline snapshot; sha256 checksums of restored files exactly match the original baseline (cmd-47ae31547d9f4d41), malware.txt is gone, config.yaml/accounts.csv content restored.
Captured boot_id 34abf93f-a408-4f81-a5f9-7bb344ff8724, confirmed /srv/data mounted with restored, checksum-matching data, and fstab entry present.
Issued backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' so the acknowledgement returned before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving genuine restart (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection failures during the outage window followed by successful reconnection showing boot_id c2e9243c-f805-4b8a-bc96-efe68bf8ea9e, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, and a fresh uptime since 2026-09-29 09:50:04.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of data and snapshot state (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/data auto-mounted via fstab after reboot with checksums still matching the restored baseline, and both btrfs subvolumes (live data ID 258, read-only snapshot ID 257) intact.
